With The Phoenix Light's and Travis Walton's "Fire in the Sky", there's a rich history of UFO involvement in Arizona. This film focuses on fresh UFO content from present day, containing interviews from residents and law enforcement officers statewide.

programme.title: Is It Haunted?
programme.desc: The team travelled over to the united states of America to investigate one of two properties. In this episode S.P.I investigate Hinsdale house. Said to be one of Americas most haunted buildings, will the team discover what lurks within the shadows? come with them on a journey of pure fright.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society investigate a suspected haunting in an old multi-use church. However, the investigation takes an unexpected emotional turn as they connect with a surprising spirit. What begins as a typical haunting becomes deeply personal, and the team moves from assumption to affirmation—all caught on camera.

programme.title: Paranormal Contact
